segments.name: Energy Storage Solutions
segments.description: Sells and licenses gravity, battery and green hydrogen energy storage systems, software and integration services to utilities, independent power producers and large energy users.
segments.evidence: The Company reports its operating results and financial information in one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including utilities, independent power producers and large energy users, pay for energy storage equipment, licensing, software, integration and long-term services, and for owned storage capacity.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell and license our energy storage solutions to third parties, in addition to selectively owning and operating energy storage systems that incorporate our energy storage equipment and software.
